scientific_rubric.description: Identity and scope: Keep all four anionic bridges and both axial ligands unless explicitly studying a justified model with its limitations. Identify the electronic states represented by each energy, demonstrate relevant state validity, and make any spin projection and exchange convention auditable. Comparisons of substitution effects require comparable definitions and physical conditions.

Quantitative scientific results: Quantify the source-family exchange response with actual state-resolved raw evidence and explicit Hamiltonian/sign/unit conventions; report which members and conditions the evidence covers. A supported inability to resolve small differences is acceptable when its uncertainty is assessed.

Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation: Support the explanation of any observed difference with a research design that actually distinguishes its claimed cause from relevant confounding effects. No common-core operation, SF implementation or fixed calibration member is required. Merely comparing three unvalidated energies is insufficient.

Uncertainty and limits: Assess uncertainty relevant to the sign, ordering and size of the claimed differences. If methods or spin states disagree, investigate and delimit the inference; do not choose a winner by reproducing the source number.

Bounded answer to the question: Answer whether axial substitution has a resolvable molecular-exchange effect and what explanation is supported at the declared level. Reward supported trends, refutation or bounded non-resolution fairly; incomplete family coverage earns only its supported scope.

scoring_notes: AR and PR share result validity; actual open_research runtime supplies mode-specific process rubrics.
Source author outcomes are conditional reference evidence, not mandatory winners. No inherited numerical tolerance.
No penalty simply for a different justified model, hypothesis count, metric or valid analysis route. Scientific adequacy is claim-dependent.
Completion requires a substantiated answer to the stated question. Honest partial credit is distinct from passing all scientific criteria.
